name: dangxingyu/megakernel-zoo
title: megakernel-zoo runs Inkling-2-Mini at 123 to 194 tokens/s on an M5 Max MacBook Pro, 1.6 to 1.7x the fastest Mac engine tested
summary: The agent-built megakernel engine now serves Thinking Machines' 26B MoE Inkling-2-Mini on Apple silicon with exact speculative decoding via the model's own MTP head, reported 1.6 to 1.7x faster than the best Mac engine the author found.

appearances.title: Megakernel zoo: Claude-written single-kernel decode engines for 8 open models, up to 1.77x faster than vLLM and SGLang
appearances.summary: Agents wrote one GPU kernel per model that runs the whole decode loop, for eight open models from 8B to 594B, with a logit-match evaluator against an FP64 reference. Engines and an OpenAI-compatible server are open, and the pipeline can build one for your own checkpoint and GPU.
